transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Your Name]. What brings you in today?

Um… I guess I’m here because I’m having a hard time keeping things organized. Like, my schoolwork and this little accessories shop I’m trying to run… everything ends up in piles—supplies, receipts, assignment notes, due dates. I just don’t really know what to do first.
Have you been feeling down, sad, or have you lost interest in things you usually enjoy?
I don’t think so… not really. I mean, I get frustrated, but I haven’t really noticed being sad or losing interest in things.
Do you ever feel worried or restless, like you can't sit still or you're on edge?
Yeah… kind of. Even if I’m not doing anything, I feel like my body is sort of… buzzing. Like I need to move, especially if I’m supposed to just sit there and listen.
Do you often find yourself fidgeting, tapping your hands or feet, or moving around when you’re supposed to stay still?
Yeah… I do. In lectures or study groups, my leg’s usually bouncing, or I’ll be clicking a pen. Sometimes I’m messing with beads or key rings in my bag before I even realize I’m doing it.
How long have you been feeling this way? Have these problems with staying still and getting organized been happening for most of your life, or is this something that started more recently?

I think it’s been… pretty much always. My mom still has notes from elementary school saying I was out of my seat a lot, talking before I was called on, and rushing through group activities, even when I knew the work. So I don’t think it’s new.
